text: This program is designed for students who are keen to learn Chinese language .The courses within this program focus on language skills of listening ,Speaking .Reading and Wriing .Students are able to make basic conversations through first years' study,will have a comprehensive understanding of Chinese Language and be able to enter into the Bachelor Degree programs after completion of 2 years' study. Course Feature (1)Small-sized teaching mode and equal opportunity to interact with the lecturers (2)Placement test can recommend the most appropriate levels to students (3)One-to-one learning system between Chinese students and internatinal students enable them to practice Chinese language and understand more about the Chinese culture easily. We arrange field trips to historical site every semester and organize sightseeing activities and cultural visits in Zhejiang aperiodically
